data_reconstruction_notes.summary: This alpha's ORIGINAL discovery measurement (expected_stats_at_freeze above) was computed on data_v2/normalized/event_feature_panel, a STATIC one-shot backfill that exists only in the separate futur-data-v2 worktree (branch research/market-physics-data-v3) and is NOT continuously updated. The LIVE implementation below reads a genuinely different, continuously-updating source instead: data/derivatives_raw/ (this repo's own live derivatives collector). It is a documented RECONSTRUCTION of the same economic state on different plumbing, NOT a byte-for-byte replication -- treat expected_stats_at_freeze as directional context for edge_retention tracking, not as a guarantee this exact live rule will reproduce those numbers.

PEPEUSDT/RNDRUSDT are in principle recoverable by fixing the collector's symbol list, but that file (scripts/run_derivatives_collector.py / its systemd unit) is shared live infrastructure outside this mission's stated deliverables -- NOT modified here per the additive-only hard rule. The engine returns [] for these 3 symbols (logged WARNING, never a crash, never a fabricated value) and the runner counts/reports them per run.

reconstruction_methodology.what_is_structurally_equivalent: Same economic content as the original: causal trailing price return (1h) and OI %-change (1h) per symbol, hourly cadence, evaluated across the frozen-50 universe, forward horizon 4h. The live source's native cadence (~5-6min REST poll) is FINER than the original panel's (5min grid resampled to top-of-hour), so resampling live data DOWN to top-of-hour bars via causal merge_asof(direction='backward', tolerance=2h) is a faithful match, not a degradation.
what_is_NOT_verified_or_is_a_judgment_ca: The original W2 REPORT.md worker's analysis script that produced evidence/leverage_oi_O1_O9_full.json was EPHEMERAL (a subagent run, per the report's own header note about a harness constraint preventing it from writing files) -- only REPORT.md and the evidence JSON survive, the code does not. The exact decile boundary (this module assumes symmetric top/bottom 10%, i.e. PRICE_PCTILE_HI=0.90 / OI_PCTILE_LO=0.10) and the population used for the percentile (this module assumes a per-symbol TIME-SERIES trailing window, matching this codebase's dominant convention elsewhere e.g. data_v2's funding_rate_percentile_90d -- NOT a cross-sectional-across-symbols percentile, which was also plausible) were inferred, not recovered.

The percentile lookback window (this module uses 720h/30 days trailing) was NOT specified anywhere in the source materials -- chosen as a reasonable middle ground against other window conventions already used in this repo (funding uses 90d, positioning LSR uses 7d). A different window would flag a different, though presumably similar-order-of-magnitude, set of bars.

Whether the original evidence's 'quadrant_tail_deciles' used the SAME grid points to build both percentiles or resampled differently is unknown; this module builds both price_ret_1h and oi_delta_pct_1h percentiles off the identical causal hourly grid, which is the simplest self-consistent choice.

sanity_check_performed.method: Ran ShortCoveringContinuationEngine.generate() live across all 47 available frozen-universe symbols over a real trailing 72h window (2026-08-28 17:00 UTC -> 2026-08-31 17:00 UTC, current wall-clock at freeze time) with the full 720h percentile lookback populated from real collected history.
sanity_check_performed.result: 3,431 symbol-hours evaluated; 28 classified strict SHORT_COVERING (A_TRADE, score>=0.90) = 0.82% of all bars; 153 additional near-miss B_SHADOW rows (score in [0.75, 0.90)) = 4.46%. Zero SHORT/SHORT_HEDGE rows emitted (asserted).
sanity_check_performed.comparison: 0.82% (live reconstruction, A_TRADE only) vs 1.14% (original discovery's tail-decile population, 23422/2055173) -- same order of magnitude, both far below the ~25% a naive sign(price_ret)>0 AND sign(oi_delta)<0 split would produce with no tail conditioning. This is consistent with -- not proof of -- a structurally similar rule; the live sample (3,431 bars over 3 days) is far too small to statistically confirm the 0.82% vs 1.14% gap is sampling noise vs a genuinely looser/tighter live threshold. Re-check this ratio periodically as more live history accumulates.

data_reconstruction_notes.honest_verdict: Data IS genuinely live and currently updating (verified against real files, real mtimes, a real running process) for 47/50 frozen symbols. The classification RULE is a documented, defensible, but UNVERIFIED reconstruction of the original tail-decile mechanism -- not a byte-for-byte replica, because the original analysis code was never persisted. status=SHADOW_LIVE / data_live=true reflects confidence in the DATA being real-time; it does NOT claim the live rule is proven identical to what earned the +9.2/+19.0bps excess numbers. Edge retention should be tracked from live_start_timestamp forward as an independent measurement of THIS rule, not assumed equal to expected_stats_at_freeze.
